title: DOCOM CertificateFollowUpUpdated event (v1)
description: Event emitted when the Part III follow-up records on a TRACES DOCOM certificate are observed or republished as a detached payload. Certificate aggregate; subType is DOCOM. data is defra-unvtd-profile-docom-followup-v1 (certificateIdentifier + followUp[]). Prefer this event when follow-ups change without a certificate reissue. When TRACES returns follow-ups with the certificate itself, they also appear inline as data.followUp on CertificateUpdated — consumers should treat the two as the same FollowUpRecord shape, not competing models.
